title: Link new device
noHub: Pair a Machine first. The new device links through the Hub your Machines are on.

show.heading: On the new device, open Veeloe, choose Use with a device I already have, and scan this
show.footer: Expires {{when}}. It works once. Linking is only for your own devices.
show.label: QR code to link a new device
show.link: No camera on the new device? Open or paste this link there
show.secret: This QR code and link hold a secret. Only give them to your own new device, and don't keep a photo of them.

expired: This QR code expired before a new device used it.

ask.heading: A device asks to be linked
ask.label: Name of the new device
ask.footer: Approve only if this is the device in front of you. This device will vouch for its key, and it will be able to command all your Machines. If you don't recognize the name, cancel.

name.taken: You already have a device called {{name}}

prompt: Link {{name}}. This device will vouch for its key

sending.heading: Sending your Machines to the new device…
sending.body: Keep the app open on the new device until this finishes.
